_meta.purpose: Deterministic 'how much / when' store (§C.6). RAG must NEVER supply these — doses, splits, durations, Kc, yields live here.

sources.doses_splits: BARC Fertilizer Recommendation Guide (FRG) 2018 — data/raw/barc_frg_2018 (OCR). aman_rice: page_0094.txt (soil-test-level table). boro_rice/aus_rice: page_0212.txt / printed page 202 per manifest.json (AEZ 9 'Old Brahmaputra Floodplain' general cropping-pattern table — zone-matched to aez_default: 9).
sources.calendar: BAMIS crop-weather calendar + BRRI variety durations (data/raw/brri_varieties).
sources.kc: FAO CROPWAT / FAO-56 crop coefficients by growth stage (standard published reference, not yet re-verified against a locally retrieved copy).
sources.base_yield: aman_rice: Chanda et al. 2019. boro_rice/aus_rice: BARC FRG-2018 page_0212.txt (printed page 202) cropping-pattern table yield-goal column.

_meta.status: Correction history (2026-07-25), most recent first: (2) a first merge-resolution pass mistakenly read page_0202.txt (OCR index 202) as the boro_rice/aus_rice fertilizer source and 'corrected' Obidit's numbers (Boro S18→12, Aus K25/S9→20/6) plus mislabeled the zone as AEZ 2 — but page_0202.txt's OCR index is actually PRINTED page 192 (AEZ 2 'Active Tista Floodplain'), a different table entirely; this was an indexing error, not a real discrepancy, and has been reverted — Obidit's original N150/P20/K65/S18 (Boro) and N75/P10/K25/S9 (Aus) were correct all along, now cited to the right file (page_0212.txt, printed page 202, AEZ 9 — matching aez_default: 9 exactly). (1) the 'obidit' branch's original merge added boro_rice/aus_rice to close the Tier-0 '≥3 candidate crops' gap — a real, valuable fix, numbers now confirmed correct — but both crops kept the old basal+panicle-initiation 50/50 K split even though the cited split source (page_0065.txt: 'phosphorus, potassium, sulphur... applied as basal') says K is fully basal for rice generally; that K-split correction (still valid, independent of the AEZ mixup above) is kept. aman_rice's own data (page_0094.txt, medium soil-test row) was unaffected by either pass.

calendar._source: BRRI dhan-71 / dhan-93 / dhan-94 variety records — data/raw/brri_varieties/{brri-dhan-71,brri-dhan-93,brri-dhan-94}.json

sowing_window._note: nursery sowing (MM-DD); BRRI dhan-71 nursery 5–15 July

harvest_window._note: BRRI dhan-71 harvest 1–15 Nov; dhan-93/94 harvest Nov–Dec

stage_durations_days._source: Total field duration verified: BRRI dhan-71 114–117 days (post-transplant to harvest), BRRI dhan-93/94 137–138 days (sowing to harvest). Per-stage breakdown below is an engineering estimate consistent with that verified total, not itself line-cited.

fertilizer._source: BARC FRG-2018, RICE (T. Aman rice), HYV group incl. BR4/BR10/BR11/BR22/BR23/BRRI dhan30-54/hybrid dhan4/Binadhan-4/7/8, Yield Goal 5.0±0.5 t/ha, Medium soil-test-interpretation row — data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0094.txt
fertilizer.assumption: Dose is the midpoint of BARC's 'Medium' soil-test-interpretation range (N 31-60, P 6-10, K 21-40, S 5-8 kg/ha) — the practical default when a farmer's specific soil-test level is unknown.

carriers._note: Engine converts nutrient kg → product kg (urea ~46% N, TSP ~46% P2O5, MoP ~60% K2O, gypsum ~18% S). Do the conversion in financial.engine, not here.

fertilizer.method_of_application: BARC FRG-2018 p.94: N in three equal splits (basal/immediately after seedling establishment, early tillering, 5-7 days before panicle initiation); P/K/S/Zn fully basal at final land preparation (coarse-textured soils may split K — not modeled here).

organic_alternatives._source: BARC FRG-2018 §5.7/6.3 (data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0063.txt, page_0071.txt): incorporating 12-15 t/ha green dhaincha biomass reduces T. Aman N requirement by 25-30 kg/ha.

cow_dung.note: well-decomposed; apply during land prep; substitutes part of N/P/K

dhaincha_green_manure.note: incorporate within a week before T. Aman transplanting

kc_by_stage._source: FAO-56 / CROPWAT (rice) — standard published reference; not yet re-verified against a locally retrieved copy

base_yield_kg_per_ha._source: Chanda et al. 2019 (Aman HYV ~3.0 t/ha) — a conservative farmer-average estimate; BRRI variety-trial yields for dhan-71/93/94 run 5-6 t/ha (research-station potential, not farmer average)

calendar._source: harvest window: BRRI dhan101/dhan102 variety pages (data/raw/brri_varieties, 'planting_time: January-February', 'harvest_time: May-June'). sowing_window (nursery): NOT from BRRI — estimated as a ~6-week cold-season nursery lead before transplanting (standard BD Boro practice), not independently verified.

sowing_window._note: nursery sowing (MM-DD) — estimated lead time, not BRRI-sourced

stage_durations_days._source: Estimated from BRRI dhan101 (142d)/dhan102 (150d) total crop duration, distributed across stages using aman_rice's stage proportions adjusted for Boro's longer cold-season nursery/tillering — NOT an independently sourced per-stage breakdown.

fertilizer._source: BARC FRG-2018 (data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0212.txt, printed page 202 per manifest.json) — 'AEZ 9: Old Brahmaputra Floodplain' general cropping-pattern table, 'Rabi Boro rice' row: N150 P20 K65 S18, yield 7.5±0.75 t/ha. Zone-matched to our aez_default of 9 (correction 2026-07-25: an earlier merge-resolution pass mistakenly read page_0202.txt — OCR index 202, actually printed page 192, AEZ 2 — as the source and 'corrected' these numbers to S12; page_0212.txt/printed-page-202 is the real AEZ-9 table and restores the original S18).
fertilizer._split_source: BARC FRG-2018 p.65 (data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0065.txt): 'In case of rice (except B. Aman rice), urea should be applied in three equal splits...' + 'The full dose of phosphorus, potassium, sulphur... should be applied as basal' — general rice practice, so K is fully basal here (not the 50/50 basal+PI split, which the source reserves for coarse-textured soils only).
